front: observation
back: Something you notice using your five senses.

front: inference
back: An idea you figure out based on what you noticed.

front: variable
back: The one thing you change in a scientific test.

front: data
back: Facts you collect and write down during an experiment.

front: prediction
back: A guess about what will happen in an experiment.

front: fair test
back: An experiment where you change only one variable at a time.
